policy.supported_changes: Owners may patch only the specifically supported text fields and corresponding semantic references or labels. Preserve surviving literal signs, qualifiers, spelling, and placement. Do not silently force printed source discrepancies to a peer’s wording.
policy.before_snapshots: Before applying a reading, preserve the current TXT, source-layout model, verification/review notes, preview quartet, relevant source model/generator, and source TIFF provenance with exact hashes. Preserve historical confirmation and review records.

policy.preconditions: Check each stable ID against the current source scan, target fragment, coordinates, semantic field boundaries, and current hashes before editing. policy.independent_reacceptance: After supported edits, independently inspect the current TIFF and the complete current TXT/model/verification-or-review-notes/preview quartet, including the full-page preview. Reaccept the page with current source and artifact hashes before any repository mirroring.
policy.mirroring: Mirror only the independently reaccepted current artifacts and receipts through the established owner workflow. These handoffs themselves grant no page acceptance and make no repository or canonical changes.
policy.human_history: Never replace a prior raw human answer with a source-derived reading. The LS023/LS113 raw answers remain literally illegible; their already owner-applied recoveries are archived separately and excluded from the 494 new handoffs.
policy.unresolved_scope: Only these reviewed fields are supported. Other physical questions, tentative guesses, source limitations, and wiring checks remain separate and open unless independently resolved.
